headline: Commands, joins, and sticker reports
intro: This release tightens everyday group behaviour. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Command menu
Tapping a suggestion such as /help in a group now runs correctly when Telegram inserts the bot username (/help@BotName).
Telegram bots
Bots you add from BotFather are no longer kicked on join. Join verification still applies to people. Raidmode still stops flood joins, not official bots.
Member status
/stats (reply or @username) now shows immune, trusted, approved, and sticker warnings as separate fields.
Sticker reports

A /report now bans that sticker and its pack, and is enforced for members and admins. Only the owner can /unreport or /unreportall confirm. Removal notices tag the sender; rapid spam is grouped into one message.
Admin demote
Three banned-sticker warnings still demote an admin this bot promoted with /makeadmin. The next banned sticker after that is a kick.

headline: Hand cricket and game cards
intro: This update is about match rules and how games look in the group. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Hand cricket
If you are out for 0, the other side only needs 1 to win. The chase now ends as soon as that target is passed — they do not keep batting to 18. Your number locks for that ball and cannot be changed.
Scoreboard cards
Cricket, toss, lucky 7, and duels post a graphic card with both player names, score, and who is batting.

headline: New games and per-game boards
intro: Three new two-player games, and a wins/losses board for each game. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Four in a row
/four @username — a visible board. Drop in columns 1–7. First to four in a line wins.
Penalty duel
/penalty — five kicks each. Shooter and keeper pick Left, Centre, or Right. Same side is a save.
The vault
/vault — both lock Share or Take. Split, steal, or both walk away empty.
Per-game leaderboard
/top cricket, /top four, /top penalty, and the other games show wins, losses, and draws. /balance lists your line for each.

headline: Games removed for a rebuild
intro: All games, coins, and per-game boards are removed while they get rebuilt cleanly. Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Games and leaderboard
Daily bonus, toss, dice, lucky 7, hand cricket, four in a row, penalty duel, the vault, balances, and every leaderboard are gone for now. This clears out bugs found in the old game engine.
Everything else
Moderation, verify, notes, whisper, scold, and the calculator are unaffected.

headline: Makeadmin now works on bots
intro: Only what changed is listed below.
sections: Promoting a bot
/makeadmin can now promote a bot the same way it promotes a person - reply to it or tag it. It still only touches admins it promoted itself.
